# Student Performance Analysis

Explore a synthetic educational dataset using clustering and descriptive feature analysis.

## Required behavior
- [ ] Data exploration
- [ ] Scaling
- [ ] K-means
- [ ] Cluster evaluation
- [ ] Dimensionality reduction
- [ ] Written interpretation

Use a synthetic or properly licensed dataset. Keep training, selection, and final evaluation separate. Document setup, package versions, evaluation, limitations, and reset instructions.

dataset_note: Where provided, use only for educational practice. Data files are deterministic synthetic examples and contain no real people. Copy into the starter project before running it.
